exposure: micromanipulation using freshly recovered non-vitrified oocytes
Conception via micromanipulation using freshly recovered non-vitrified oocytes
cohort: 50 children born after autologous oocyte vitrification and 364 children conceived by micromanipulation using freshly recovered non-vitrified oocytes
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in newborn health parameters between children conceived via autologous oocyte vitrification and children conceived by micromanipulation using freshly recovered non-vitrified oocytes.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant difference in the rate of caesarean section between children conceived via autologous oocyte vitrification and children conceived by micromanipulation using freshly recovered non-vitrified oocytes.
